basis.i: URA rental records for the same size (inferred)

flags.1: URA also records a nett price (new sale with discount); the price shown is before the discount
flags.2: PSF unusual for this development and sale type
flags.4: another record has the same month, size, floor band and price (could be two units)
flags.8: size unusual for its bedroom type

notes: Months only: URA gives the contract month, not the day.
Floor is a URA floor band; exact floors and unit numbers are not available and are never inferred.
Area is URA whole square metres; sq ft is converted and approximate.
Bedroom type is inferred by Groundwork, never recorded by URA; unknown where the size could be more than one type.
